title: A Escarpment for the Trail
author: Rafael Winterbourne
blurb: Hazel Okonkwo, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
